title: Test-suite shell — not a course
note: SHELL FOR THE TEST SUITE. This is not a course, has never been taught, and must never be deployed: no signer URL, no webapp URL, a deliberately worthless salt, and no banks of its own (it borrows the demo course's). It exists for one reason: the assignment-resolution tests need a course with a realistic set of weekly assignments, and that structure used to come from a real course whose content no longer ships with the engine (INV-COURSE-3). Weeks skip 10 ON PURPOSE — "Quiz 10" must be REFUSED rather than guessed, and a shell with no gap could not test that.
pseudonymSaltNote: Fixed and worthless on purpose. Never copy this into a real course.

week-01-intro-and-scope.shortTitleNote: The short label the app shows above the quiz, and the only assignment text stamped into a link (INV-USE-1). It exists because these ids name their topics — `week-04-methods-core` would tell a student the subject before a question was served, both on screen and inside the link. gen-url.js REFUSES to mint for an assignment whose id carries no quiz number and has no shortTitle, which is exactly this course. A week number is deliberately not derived from the id: week 4 is not necessarily quiz 4, and a confidently wrong number is worse than none.
